q: What is a graphic clip?
a: A graphic clip sits on a video track like any clip and holds layers (text and shapes) drawn back to front. Window ▸ Essential Graphics lists the selected graphic clip's layers; Effect Controls shows each layer's properties, which can be keyframed. Graphics and Titles ▸ New Layer makes Text (`graphics.newText`, Cmd+T), vertical text (`graphics.newVerticalText`), Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon or From file….

q: In Premiere I'd use Essential Graphics to make a title. Same here?
a: Yes: Graphics and Titles ▸ New Layer ▸ Text makes a graphic clip at the playhead; Window ▸ Essential Graphics lists its layers and templates, Effect Controls holds each layer's properties.

q: How do I change a text layer's stroke and shadow?
a: Font, size, colour, stroke, shadow and the rest are layer properties (`graphics.set`); type the text in the Program monitor or with `graphics.setText`. With a text layer selected, `graphics.fontSizeUp` / `fontSizeDown` change the size (Shift: five steps) and `graphics.leadingUp` / `leadingDown` the line spacing; `graphics.alignTextLeft` / `Center` / `Right` align it.

q: How do I change line spacing in a title?
a: Font, size, colour, stroke, shadow and the rest are layer properties (`graphics.set`); type the text in the Program monitor or with `graphics.setText`. With a text layer selected, `graphics.fontSizeUp` / `fontSizeDown` change the size (Shift: five steps) and `graphics.leadingUp` / `leadingDown` the line spacing; `graphics.alignTextLeft` / `Center` / `Right` align it.

q: How do I bring a layer to the front?
a: Order layers with bring to front / forward and send to back / backward (`graphics.bringToFront`, `graphics.sendBackward` …). Nudge a layer a pixel with the arrow keys (`graphics.nudgeLeft` …), five with Shift. Align to the frame, the selection or within a group, and distribute by centres or by the space between.

q: How do I nudge a graphics layer by one pixel?
a: Order layers with bring to front / forward and send to back / backward (`graphics.bringToFront`, `graphics.sendBackward` …). Nudge a layer a pixel with the arrow keys (`graphics.nudgeLeft` …), five with Shift. Align to the frame, the selection or within a group, and distribute by centres or by the space between.

q: What is responsive design for graphics?
a: Responsive design keeps a graphic working when text or length changes: pins (`graphics.pin`) tie a layer's edges to another layer or the frame; protected time (`graphics.setResponsiveTime`) keeps the first and last seconds' animation when the clip is trimmed; a roll scrolls credits up and a crawl runs a ticker sideways (`graphics.setRoll`), optionally starting and ending off screen.

q: Where are graphics templates stored?
a: Templates are `.fcgt` files in your data folder; `graphics.template.install` adds one you were sent and `graphics.template.remove` removes one. Apply from Essential Graphics ▸ Browse (`graphics.template.apply`); `graphics.template.controls` lists the editable properties and `graphics.template.set` changes them. Built-in templates are Revolution's own designs.

q: In Premiere I'd export a Motion Graphics Template. How do I do that in Revolution?
a: Select the graphic clip and choose Export As Motion Graphics Template (`graphics.template.export`), picking which properties stay editable. It saves a Revolution `.fcgt` template (Adobe `.mogrt` files aren't read).

q: What does Upgrade to Source Graphic change?
a: It makes the graphic's layers belong to its project item, so every clip of that item shows the same layers and editing one updates the others, even when you didn't mean it to.

q: How do I find which fonts my project uses?
a: `graphics.fonts.used` lists every font the project's graphics use; Replace Fonts in Projects swaps one font for another in every graphic at once.

q: What's inside a .fcpack file?
a: A look pack (`.fcpack`) bundles your effect presets (with keyframes and masks), LUTs from the current project's library (`.cube` / `.3dl`) and your installed graphics templates (`.fcgt`). It's a plain zip with a small `pack.json` list inside. Resolve exports PowerGrades and LUTs separately and Premiere presets and templates separately; a pack holds all three.

q: Is a look pack the same as a PowerGrade?
a: A look pack (`.fcpack`) bundles your effect presets (with keyframes and masks), LUTs from the current project's library (`.cube` / `.3dl`) and your installed graphics templates (`.fcgt`). q: What does Export Look Pack include by default?
a: By default `packs.export` takes all your presets, every LUT in the project and all your installed templates; pass names in `presets`, `luts` or `templates` to choose. An empty selection is refused rather than writing an empty pack.

q: What limits does a look pack import check?
a: Only presets, LUTs and templates are accepted, with plain names (no folders or paths), at most 2048 files and 512 MB unpacked, and every LUT and template must read correctly; Adobe `.mogrt` files are refused. If anything is wrong, nothing from that part is added and the message names the file and the rule.
